summary: Fresh Codex tool-broker acceptance remained blocked before main delivery
details: The paired providers and real Edge interaction passed independently. The final commit 0adcbeb produced a clean scoped diff and 523 tests with one skip. The packaged client selected the pair in fresh Arabic requests, but both workspace-write and read-only tool launch were blocked by Windows provisioning/process identity. The official portable client passed the archive integrity check and could open a session, but its model requests were not supported for this account. DoneProof T1 and T2 are verified and T3 is partial. GitHub main baseline workflows passed and Git dry-run reported a fast-forward. No main push had occurred at this point. The npm archive SHA-512 was verified against registry metadata; registry signatures were not independently verified.
